notes: Noodles weighed dry (wholewheat pasta value, as SA wholewheat noodles are durum/wholewheat flour and water, no egg); chicken breast raw, skinless; all 2 tbsp oil eaten; both limes' juice counted since the wedges are squeezed over (~4 kcal a serving either way); shredded cabbage ~74 g a 250 ml cup; baby corn from a USDA-based frozen baby corn entry because SR Legacy has none (fresh sweet corn kernels at 86 kcal would add ~25 kcal a serving). Sanity check (published figures as recalled; web search was unavailable): chicken and vegetable noodle stir-fries for 4 with 200–250 g dry noodles and 400–500 g chicken list 430–520 kcal a serving (e.g. wholewheat-noodle chicken stir-fries at ~450–500 kcal; versions with honey or oyster sauce run 550+). Ours at 510 is within that range; it has more chicken than most and no sweet sauce.
